For visitors

Free. Sign Landry's waiver once a year (online or in the store). Helmet and flat-repair kit required, daytime flashing lights suggested. Steady rain or thunderstorms cancel.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
The easiest pace the host lists is 13–15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Landry's Braintree All Levels Road Ride group ride

Landry's Braintree All Levels Road Ride is a road group ride in Braintree, MA. It rolls every Saturday at 7:00 am from Landry's Bicycles, Braintree store.

A Saturday-morning road ride from the Braintree store with two paces, a beginner group at 13-15 mph and an enthusiast group at 16-17 mph. About two hours. Landry's says all its rides are no-drop, so choose the group that fits you.
